issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs reading the pixel value into register ECX ("mov ecx, [esi]") after computing the pixel address in ESI, but the provided solution/template read the pixel into EAX ("mov eax, [esi]") and subsequent code/pushes expect that usage. This mismatch between ECX (in the problem text) and EAX (in the template/solution code) is an identifier-level inconsistency (register name) that can confuse students when they try to follow the instructions and map them to the template or reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register usage consistent across all artifacts. Either update the problem statement to request the pixel value be read into EAX (e.g. change "mov ecx, [esi]" to "mov eax, [esi]") or modify the template/solution to read into ECX (change "mov eax, [esi]" to "mov ecx, [esi]") and adjust subsequent pushes/uses accordingly. Prefer aligning the problem statement to match the template/solution or vice versa so students have a single, unambiguous target.
